_README: TEMPLATE. Copy to spikes/evidence/<scenario_id>-<device_id>.json, set scenario_id, fill every field from a PHYSICAL device run, delete all keys starting with underscore. Unfilled (null) fields are INVALID and the scenario stays PENDING. Never set synthetic=true for real evidence; synthetic and emulator/simulator files never count.

TZD-AND-01.title: Device zone identifier is IANA and resolvable for the sample zone set
TZD-AND-01.pass_criteria: Every sample zone resolves; legacy aliases resolve or are mapped.

TZD-AND-02.title: OS offsets agree with the bundled tzdb at sampled instants
TZD-AND-02.pass_criteria: Zero mismatches over at least 200 sampled instants including transitions; otherwise record the zones and versions.
